dpanel.desc:
DPanel 是一款轻量化的管理 Docker、Podman 容器的可视化面板。
原生的中文的界面，更适合中文环境使用。同时支持英文、日文等多种语言。安装简单，占用资源极低，更适合各种 Nas 设备、盒子以及小型服务器。交流反馈群：837583876

1.11.3.changelog:
feat: toggle panel features and shortcuts; menus and actions respect feature dependencies and user permissions feat: guide the panel owner through the main features and let them replay the tour from system settings feat: read release notes before a panel upgrade and expand the execution log while it runs feat: sort the container list by status, including health checks, to find unhealthy or restarting containers (#336) feat: quickly create an empty file or directory from the file manager context menu, or jump to a directory with path suggestions feat: rename files while editing without overwriting existing files; enter numeric UID and GID values when changing ownership feat: connect TCP/TLS and SSH Docker environments, host terminals, and SSH file access through an SSH jump host (#255) feat: browse and sync the System Plugins catalog; the plugin and 1Panel store pages flag available source updates feat: configure container memory-plus-swap limits during creation and recreation feat: show per-layer image pull progress during batch container updates and let users skip the current pull to continue with the next container (#331) feat: open console settings from log views to set the default container shell, font and cursor style, log view, line count, line numbers, and timestamps (#333) feat: refresh management lists from the right-click menu feat: delete external Compose tasks even when YAML is missing or empty; task details offer separate image and volume cleanup options feat: attempt to remove unused installer images from the default Docker environment after the installer exits fix: preserve standalone comments, blank lines, and variable order when saving Compose `.env` files fix: package valid language files so English and Japanese panel initialization does not fail on malformed JSON fix: connect the terminal with default settings when console preferences cannot be loaded fix: save App Store source settings before synchronization and retain them after synchronization failures fix: after a failed App Store deployment, remove the failed task, its containers and task directory, then keep the form ready to retry fix: load complete Docker environment settings for editing and preserve unchanged SSH and jump-host credentials fix: refresh update checks older than ten minutes when opening container details (#334) fix: show image details even when Docker cannot return the layer history fix: use the current WebSocket identifier for requests and wait for it before subscribing to execution progress fix: report request failures consistently without duplicating errors handled by the operation fix: prepare the recovery command before upgrading the panel and no longer force a reload after three minutes fix: report monitoring startup failures and stop old sampling tasks from overwriting the current connection status after a disconnect refactor: sync supported App Store and plugin sources using built-in mirrors ordered by reachability, with Docker Hub as a fallback refactor: detect unreachable Docker environments sooner, including SSH jump-host connections refactor: improve PE image-directory browsing with read-only mounts or merged image layers, and release browsing resources on close refactor: allow flat sidebars without menu grouping and remove the separate Quick Access page refactor: ask for confirmation before interrupting an image pull refactor: simplify shared-memory configuration with default/custom modes and capacity-unit validation Note: System Plugins does not yet support installation or runtime configuration. Unregistered external Compose tasks with purely numeric names remain unsupported.

增加 功能和快捷入口开关，菜单与操作按功能依赖和用户权限显示 增加 面向面板创建者的功能向导，可在系统设置中再次查看 增加 面板升级窗口支持升级前查看版本变更、升级中展开执行日志 增加 容器列表按状态排序，可优先查看不健康、正在重启等异常容器（#336） 增加 文件管理右键快速新建空文件或目录，也可输入路径、按目录提示跳转 增加 编辑文件时可同时改名，不覆盖同名文件；修改所有者和所属组时可直接输入 UID 和 GID 增加 SSH 跳板机配置，支持 Docker TCP/TLS、SSH 连接及主机终端、SSH 文件访问（#255） 增加 系统插件页面，可浏览插件详情、同步内置目录；插件页和受支持的 1Panel 商店均会提示来源更新 增加 创建和重建容器时配置内存与 Swap 总上限 增加 批量更新容器时可查看镜像各层的拉取进度，也可跳过当前拉取并继续更新下一个容器（#331） 增加 从日志界面打开控制台设置，可调整容器默认 Shell、字体和光标样式，以及日志视图、行数、行号和时间戳（#333） 增加 管理列表右键刷新 增加 外部 Compose 任务删除，即使 YAML 文件缺失或为空也可移除关联容器；任务详情可分别选择是否清理镜像和卷 增加 安装器退出后，尝试清理默认 Docker 环境中的闲置安装器镜像 修复 保存 Compose `.env` 时丢失独立注释、空行和变量顺序 修复 语言包 JSON 格式错误导致英文、日文界面可能无法完成初始化 修复 控制台偏好读取失败时无法连接终端，改用默认设置继续连接 修复 应用商店来源保存依赖同步成功，同步失败后保留配置供重试 修复 商店应用部署失败后残留任务、容器和任务目录的问题，清理后保留表单供重试 修复 Docker 环境编辑配置回填不全、未修改的 SSH 和跳板机凭据丢失 修复 打开容器详情时未刷新超过十分钟的更新检查结果（#334） 修复 Docker 无法返回镜像层历史时打不开镜像详情 修复 WebSocket 标识过期或未就绪导致请求与执行进度关联异常 修复 请求失败提示不一致及业务已处理错误时重复通知 修复 面板更新前未准备手动恢复命令，取消等待三分钟后强制刷新 修复 监控启动失败未提示，以及断连后旧采样任务覆盖当前连接状态 优化 应用商店和插件源同步：受支持的来源按连通性选择内置镜像，必要时回退到 Docker Hub 优化 Docker 环境不可达与断连检测，减少 SSH 跳板机等场景的等待 优化 专业版镜像目录浏览，支持只读挂载或镜像层合并，关闭后释放浏览资源 优化 菜单布局，支持取消分组、平铺侧边栏，移除独立“快捷访问”页面 优化 中断镜像拉取前增加确认，避免误操作 优化 共享内存配置，支持默认／自定义切换及容量单位校验 说明：系统插件暂不支持安装和运行配置；未纳入面板管理的纯数字名称外部 Compose 任务仍不支持管理。
